```yaml
name: Release Beta

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release-beta:
    name: Release Beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18.x'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm install --no-save @semantic-release/github @semantic-release/npm

      - name: Create beta branch
        run: |
          git checkout -B beta
          git push origin beta

      - name: Release
        id: release
        uses: cycjimmy/semantic-release-action@v4
        with:
          semantic_release_package: '@semantic-release/github'
          extra_plugins: |
            @semantic-release/github
            @semantic-release/npm
          branch: beta
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Delete beta branch
        if: always()
        run: |
          git push origin --delete beta
```
